title: The Blue Notebook Review - Pre-Halloween Edition
description:
The latest Blue Notebook Review is here, complete with all the essential police news... and a spooky surprise!
 
📊 The Monster Mash Dashboard: Sgt. Verbeck dives into our Crime Dashboard, giving you even more insight. 
🎃 No Tricks, Just Treats (and Law Enforcement): Get the latest updates from our patrols and investigative teams.
🐾 Pet of the Week: Meet Donald! A terrifyingly cute Duck is looking for a home this Halloween! We promise this little buddy is more treat than trick.
❓ Unmasking the Answers: We tackle your submitted questions from the past week, leaving no mystery unsolved.

Don't let the darkness keep you uninformed! Stay safe and have a terrifyingly good Halloween!

Full report: https://www.santamonica.gov/blog/the-blue-notebook-a-weekly-smpd-recap-october-12-18-2025
